edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the value used as the mint recipient inside adopt, tying untrusted input to the callback path.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint, so an attacker-controlled contract receives the onERC721Received callback.
The caller-controlled num bounds the _safeMint loop, controlling how many external callbacks fire.
Local supply seeds the token IDs minted through _safeMint in adopt.
num multiplies _price to derive the required msg.value.
_price is read from storage for the multiplication used in the payment check.
num is added to supply for the maximum-supply comparison.
supply participates in the supply + num addition.
adopt executes _safeMint for each iteration, transferring control externally before minting completes.
The adopt payment require performs the _price * num multiplication.
The adopt supply require performs the supply + num addition.
onERC721Received execution during _safeMint can re-enter adopt before the mint loop finishes.
giveAway executes _safeMint for each iteration, invoking an external receiver callback.
giveAway subtracts the requested amount from the reserved counter.
The ERC721 receiver callback fired by _safeMint can re-enter giveAway.
The _to argument determines the contract address that receives the safe-mint callback.
_amount bounds the giveAway mint loop and therefore the number of callbacks.
_amount is subtracted from _reserved.
Local supply seeds the token IDs minted via _safeMint in giveAway.
withdrawAll forwards the whole balance with a low-level send before returning.
The hardcoded payout address w1 is the external recipient of the balance transfer.
